text: SortingConsumer sorts diagnostics by the last processed token (last_byte_offset). Emitted order would print all lex errors, then parse errors, then check errors, jumping back and forth; pure line and column order puts a consequence before its cause (the arity error before the missing comma). Ties at one token would be non-deterministic and break golden tests, so on-scope diagnostics are sorted by line and column after the rest (proposals/p006699-diagnostic-sorting.md).
